title: Bug 651757: [Repair Item] [Manufacturing] Warehouse Pick is not generated for Make-to-Order subassembly after registered put-away
summary: The Completely Picked calculation for production orders now includes components supplied by other production-order lines, ensuring warehouse picks are generated for make-to-order subassemblies after put-away registration.
key_points: Fixed FlowField calculation to include supplied-by components when determining if a production order is completely picked
Prevents premature completion of warehouse pick requests when subassemblies remain unpicked
Enables follow-up warehouse picks to be generated for supplied components
Added regression tests for fully picked and mixed picked/unpicked components
quote: include supplied-by production components when calculating whether a production order is completely picked
